dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Hey, I found it! The other half of the ship, it's here! *sigh* After everything we went through with the army, all our hard-won treasure is gone, and so's the ship... When Chief Janome finds out, we'll be in for the scolding of a lifetime..."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "This samurai puppet is all that's left. Hah... and we're no more capable of getting out of here on our own strength than it is."
